$comment: The practice (#255). Teaches by doing, in this order, one `hint` per step: pick a choice (scene_meadow_gate), roll a check (check_latch / check_climb), take a story turn (scene_tansy), move on the board (encounter_stones), use a card (encounter_tag: its wisps have 2 hearts, so any hit, even a graze, is the one tag the hint promises), help a knocked-down friend (encounter_bun: with two or more heroes, `friendDown` puts one of them on the ground for the others to Help Up; Bun, a captive with no deadline, is there for everybody, and is the whole lesson at a table of one), rest (rest_picnic). Nothing in it can cost anything: no damage effects, no items taken or given, no coins, no XP, every failed roll and lost fight goes on to the same next step, and every fight ends with the whole party healed, because HP outlives a scene and a hero knocked down in one fight would otherwise start the next one down. Short on purpose, so a mixed party is not slowed down much: the 30-scene bar is for a real evening's chapter, not this. See content/README.md, "The practice".
title: The Practice Meadow

goal.text: Learn how to play, one try at a time.

steps.label: Stop the wisps by the pond

scene_meadow_gate.narration: A wooden gate stands in a sunny meadow. The sign on it says PRACTICE MEADOW, NEW HEROES WELCOME. Somebody drew a smiley face on the sign, and the smiley face has a mustache.
scene_meadow_gate.hint: Everybody gets a vote here. Tap what you want to do on your phone, then tap Do it! The most votes wins.

check_latch.narration: You reach for the latch. It is tied shut with a ribbon, in a very fancy bow, the kind you put on a birthday present.
check_latch.hint: Time to roll! When your phone says Roll, tap it. A big number is great. A small number still keeps the story going.

onSuccess.narration: You find the end of the ribbon and pull. The bow falls open, the gate swings wide, and somebody on the other side claps.

onFailure.narration: The bow gets tighter. Then tighter still. A pair of curly horns pops up over the gate, and two quick hands untie it for you. "Everybody does that," says a cheerful voice.

check_climb.narration: You grab the top rail. The gate wobbles, and it squeaks like a duck every time it moves.
check_climb.hint: Time to roll! When your phone says Roll, tap it. A big number is great. A small number still keeps the story going.

onSuccess.narration: Up, over, and down on the other side without one single squeak. Somebody nearby claps.

onFailure.narration: Squeak! Squeak! Squeeeak! You land in a soft patch of clover, and somebody nearby laughs a friendly laugh. "Everybody does that," says a cheerful voice.

scene_tansy.narration: On the other side stands a faun named Tansy, with curly horns and a clipboard made of bark. "Welcome to the practice meadow," she says. "New heroes learn the ropes here. Who wants to go first?"
scene_tansy.hint: See the name that is glowing? That hero has the story turn and picks for everyone. After a pick, the turn moves on to the next hero.

scene_tansy_meadow.narration: "You practice!" says Tansy. "Walking, rolling, playing tag, helping friends up. Nobody can lose anything here. Not even a sock."

scene_tansy_clipboard.narration: Tansy shows you the clipboard. It is a list of every hero who ever practiced here, and next to each name she drew a little star. "You get a star at the end," she says.

scene_practice_field.narration: Tansy leads you to a field of flat stepping stones with a little garden gate at the far end. Two tiny glowing wisps are napping on a mushroom: one named Flick, and his little sister Dot. They snore in sparkles.

scene_flick_wakes.narration: Flick wakes up with a snort, waves back with his whole glow, and zooms onto the stepping stones with Dot right behind him. "Race you to the garden gate!" they squeak.

encounter_stones.narration: Flick and Dot bob around the stepping stones, giggling. The garden gate waits on the far side of the field.
encounter_stones.hint: This is the board. On your turn, tap a gold square to walk there. Walk all the way to the garden gate!

onEscape.narration: You step through the garden gate. Tansy makes a tick on her clipboard. Flick and Dot arrive last, puffing little sparkles.

onVictory.narration: Before anybody reaches the gate, you tag both wisps by accident. They spin like tops and laugh so hard they hiccup.

onDefeat.narration: Flick and Dot bump everybody over into the soft grass, then look very sorry about it and help you all back up. Tansy makes a tick on her clipboard anyway.

scene_tag_field.narration: Flick and Dot zoom in a circle over your heads. "Now tag!" squeaks Flick. "Bet you can't tag me!" Tansy says a real fight works just like tag, only with cards.

scene_tag_rules.narration: "Each card is one thing your hero can do," says Tansy. "Some tag, some help, some do something special. In the practice meadow, every card is gentle." Flick and Dot are already bouncing.

encounter_tag.narration: Flick and Dot dart from stone to stone, leaving a trail of giggles.
encounter_tag.hint: Now try a card. On your turn, tap Attack, then tap a wisp. In the practice meadow, Attack is only a tag.

onVictory.narration: Tag, and tag! Flick spins in the air and lands upside down on a dandelion, and Dot lands on top of him. "No fair," says Flick. "Again tomorrow."

onDefeat.narration: The wisps tag everybody first and do a little victory loop. Then they help you all up and say it was close. It was not close.

scene_bun_mud.narration: Splash! Over by the pond, a goat kid named Bun has tipped over in the mud. All four legs are in the air, and she is waiting for somebody to help her up. Flick and Dot are buzzing around her, trying to help and not helping.

variants.text: Somebody who ran over to look slipped in too, and is lying flat on their back in the mud, giggling. They will need a hand up.

scene_bun_waits.narration: "Hold on, Bun!" you call. Bun bleats back and wiggles all four legs at once, which means thank you in goat.

encounter_bun.narration: Bun lies in the mud by the pond. Flick and Dot zip back and forth, getting in everybody's way.
encounter_bun.hint: When a friend is knocked down, stand next to them on your turn and tap Help Up. Bun is stuck in the mud: end your turn next to her to help her up too.

onEscape.narration: You head down the path home with mud on your boots.

variants.text: Bun trots along behind you, very proud of herself.
Behind you, Bun rolls over all by herself, shakes, and runs to catch up.

onVictory.narration: Tag, and tag! The wisps finally stop zipping around and sit on a reed to catch their breath.

variants.text: Bun is already on her feet, very proud of herself.
Now that it is quiet, Bun rolls over all by herself and shakes.

onDefeat.narration: Everybody slips in the mud, one after another, plop, plop, plop. Bun laughs so hard she rolls right over onto her feet.

scene_bun_safe.narration: Bun shakes the mud off her coat, all over everybody. Tansy laughs and wipes her clipboard. "Picnic time," she says. "Every hero needs a rest."

rest_picnic.narration: Tansy spreads a picnic blanket under an apple tree. Bun eats a dandelion. Flick and Dot nap in a teacup. The sun is warm, and every bump and scrape from today feels better.
rest_picnic.hint: This is a rest. Everybody gets their hearts back. When your hero has a point to spend, a rest is where you spend it.

choices.label: Ask Tansy for one more tip

scene_favorite_part.narration: Tansy writes your favorite part on her clipboard, very carefully, with her tongue sticking out. "That was my favorite part too," says Flick, who was asleep for most of it.

scene_last_tip.narration: "When you are stuck, look at your phone," says Tansy. "It only ever shows things you can really do. And if you tap the speaker, it reads them to you." Bun nods, as if she knew that already.

rest_ready.narration: Tansy draws a star next to your names on the clipboard. Then she opens a second gate, the one at the back of the meadow, and points at the road beyond it. "You are ready," she says. "Go have a real adventure." Flick waves with his whole glow.

interaction_bell.narration: Tansy hangs a little bell from the gate. “Send this soft seed into the bell,” she says. Flick floats beside it. “I will provide encouragement. DING. Like that.”

interaction.cue: Tap when the seed reaches the gold.

onSuccess.narration: Ding! Flick glows bright enough to light Tansy’s clipboard.

onFailure.narration: The seed lands in Tansy’s pocket. “Excellent pocket aim,” she says, and rings the bell herself.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy steadies your hand. The bell gives a little ding, and Flick gives a very big one.

interaction_roots.narration: Bun has tucked her ribbon beneath a springy branch. “Somebody hold the branch while somebody fetches it,” says Tansy. “A sturdy prop works too.” Bun nods. She seems very pleased with this lesson.

interaction.cue: Hold the branch while your friend fetches the ribbon.

onSuccess.narration: The ribbon slides free. Bun wears it on her head, where it is much harder to lose.

onFailure.narration: Tansy props the branch with her clipboard. Bun retrieves her ribbon herself.

onAssisted.narration: Together you tuck a prop beneath the branch. Out comes Bun’s ribbon.

interaction_stones.narration: Three painted stepping stones lead back to the picnic. Tansy hands out scraps from her clipboard. “The scraps hold clues. Share what you find!” Flick peers at his empty hands. “I know I would like more picnic.”

interaction.cue: Share your clues, then choose the stones in order.
clues: The owl comes just before the fox.

onSuccess.narration: Frog, owl, fox! The last stone makes a squeak. Flick insists that was the stone.

onFailure.narration: The stones wiggle and carry you gently back to Tansy. “A very scenic route,” she says.

onAssisted.narration: You lay every clue side by side. Frog, owl, fox. Together you find the way.

scene_team_tricks_done.narration: “Good aiming, good helping, good listening,” says Tansy. “Those are all ways to be a hero.” Flick adds a very small star to her clipboard.

scene_more_meadow_games.narration: Tansy opens a box marked SMALL ADVENTURES. Flick is already inside it. "I am the surprise," he says. Bun eats the corner of the label.

interaction_cups.narration: Flick hides his glow beneath a little cup. Tansy slides the cups around the picnic cloth. "Follow the light," she says. "Flick, no peeking out."

interaction.cue: Watch the glow, then choose its cup.

onSuccess.narration: There is Flick! "An excellent hiding place," he says, as if this was his success.

onFailure.narration: The cup is empty. Flick pops out of another one and applauds your excellent cup lifting.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

interaction_echo.narration: Flick makes little shapes of light above the picnic. "Say it back with your buttons," he says. "This is a very important wisp greeting."

interaction.cue: Watch the magic, then echo its pattern.

onSuccess.narration: Flick bows so deeply that his glow touches the grass. "A very polite greeting!"

onFailure.narration: Flick listens to your new pattern. "That means extra picnic," he decides.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

interaction_sneak.narration: Tansy covers her eyes and pretends to be a very sleepy gatekeeper. "I shall never notice anybody going past," she says. Bun walks straight past her.

interaction.cue: Step when the gatekeeper looks away.

onSuccess.narration: You tiptoe past. Tansy snores with great determination.

onFailure.narration: Tansy opens one eye. "Aha! Visitors! Would you like some picnic?"

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

interaction_balance.narration: A basket of soft rolls rests on a wide carrying tray. "Lift your side a little at a time," says Tansy. "We want the rolls to travel, not roll." Bun looks disappointed.

interaction.cue: Lift your sides until the basket is steady in the middle.

onSuccess.narration: The basket arrives without losing a roll. Bun gets one anyway.

onFailure.narration: Tansy catches the rolls in her apron. "Delivery accepted!"

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

interaction_spark.narration: Flick makes a tiny star and sends it floating toward your hands. "Catch it, then pass it along," he says. "It tickles a little."

interaction.cue: Catch the starlight, then send it to your friend.

onSuccess.narration: The little star reaches the picnic lantern. It shines with everybody’s help.

onFailure.narration: The little star lands in Tansy’s pocket. Her clipboard glows.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

scene_playful_meadow.narration: "We can just enjoy being here, too," says Tansy. Flick has several suggestions. Bun has already chosen hers.

interaction_feed.narration: Bun noses at the picnic bag. Tansy holds out a few little treats. "Let her decide what she likes," she says.

options.label: Offer an apple slice
options.reaction: Bun sniffs, crunches, and leans against your knee.

options.label: Offer a crunchy leaf
options.reaction: Bun eats the leaf and looks hopefully at your sleeve.

options.label: Scratch behind her ears
options.reaction: Bun closes her eyes and makes a very happy little bleat.

onSuccess.narration: Bun follows you back to the picnic. Apparently you are friends now.

onFailure.narration: Bun is happy to sit beside you.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

interaction_camp.narration: Tansy spreads a blanket beneath the trees. "What would make this a good camp?" she asks. Flick votes for more glow.

interaction.cue: Add something to your cozy camp.

options.label: Hang a lantern
options.reaction: A warm light appears above the blanket.

options.label: Set out a cushion
options.reaction: A soft cushion lands beside the picnic bag.

options.label: Bring some flowers
options.reaction: A little bunch of meadow flowers brightens the camp.

onSuccess.narration: Your camp is cozy because everybody brought something.

onFailure.narration: Tansy finds a comfortable spot for everyone.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

interaction_cheer.narration: "A celebration is a perfectly good use of a meadow," says Tansy. Flick is already spinning.

options.label: Give a mighty cheer
options.reaction: Your cheer sends Flick into a delighted spin.

options.label: Strike a heroic pose
options.reaction: Tansy sketches your magnificent pose on her clipboard.

options.label: Make a little sparkle
options.reaction: A little shimmer dances over the picnic.

onSuccess.narration: Tansy draws a star beside the words VERY GOOD CELEBRATING.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

interaction_wake.narration: The old stump beside the picnic has a face, and its face is asleep. "He enjoys a gentle hello," whispers Tansy.

interaction.cue: Give the sleepy stump a gentle hello.

options.label: Knock gently
options.reaction: The stump gives a sleepy rustle.

stages: The stump yawns. "Did somebody say picnic?"

onSuccess.narration: The stump settles into a comfortable grumble beside your camp.

onFailure.narration: The stump enjoys your company with his eyes closed.

onAssisted.narration: Tansy lends a hand. Flick provides encouragement, at a very impressive volume.

voiceGuide.tone: warm, playful, encouraging; a first lesson that feels like a game, never a test

npcVoices.tansy: a faun who keeps the practice meadow; patient, cheerful, says everybody does that, loves her bark clipboard
npcVoices.flick: a tiny wisp who loves tag; squeaky, boastful, a terrible loser for about two seconds
npcVoices.bun: a goat kid; only bleats, and wiggles her legs to say thank you
